Chapter 6956: No Immortals

Chapter 6956: No Immortals

Some started wondering who these new firmaments should belong to. Of course, no one dared to say anything before Li Qiye. Most likely, they would be under Apex or Heaven’s Equal’s jurisdiction.

“Now it’s time to have a nice conversation.” Li Qiye appeared before Apex again.

“May I ask what you want to know?” He took a deep breath and bowed.

“Speak about the pot.” Li Qiye said.

“I only saw it briefly in Ruin in the hand of a woman. It disappeared in the ocean of tribulations.” He sighed and revealed the truth.

“Is that it?” Li Qiye’s eyes narrowed.

“Also images of the Buddhist dao, nothing more.” He said, having no choice but to submit.

Of course, no one looked down on him for this since Li Qiye appeared to be in the celestial stage.

“Ruin.” Li Qiye said before leaving.

“Dao Brother, be careful of Ruin.” Apex couldn’t help but remark, only to realize how unnecessary the warning was.

Li Qiye turned back and smiled, glancing at the new firmaments: “You two know what to do?”

Apex and Heaven’s Equal hesitated for a moment. Apex spoke first: “With your approval, we will keep an eye on it.”

The firmaments should now belong to Li Qiye since he rebuilt them. Moreover, other immortals didn’t care about them either.

“No immortals in the mortal world.” Li Qiye ordered.

They exchanged glances before bowing: “Yes, we will not interfere with them.”

With that, Li Qiye left with his two maids.

“Close the gates and live in seclusion.” Eventually, Apex and Heaven’s Equal reached an agreement.

This shocked them more than the battles during Heaven Pit. From beginning to end, they knew nothing about Li Qiye. He refined a primordial immortal like toying with an insect. Thus, they chose to stay hidden, not wanting to antagonize Li Qiye.

***

After leaving Ancient, he told the two maids to go to Guardian. His destination, on the other hand, was Ruin.

Once Li Qiye entered Ruin, a pair of eyes emerged in an unknown location. His power exceeded any primordial immortal.

“He will eliminate all obstacles in Heavenrealm, don’t think otherwise.” This person spoke.

Previously, their group was only below the high heaven. Now, they witnessed Li Qiye’s true power but more importantly, his desire to sweep through Heavenrealm.

This was a different sweep than the high heaven’s. The latter utilized tribulations to turn everything to ashes.

During Heaven Pit, an avatar descended but failed to kill them thoroughly. As for Li Qiye, the guy wanted to kill them no matter what. They couldn’t sit idly by awaiting death.

“It is time to begin, let the high heaven come.” The person told everyone else.

***

In Ruin, Li Qiye saw tribulation bolts and flames everywhere. This major world was barely holding it together.

World of the Living was its old name, once greater than any modern world including Grand Thousand and Epoch Dawn.

It was home to numerous immortals and sects. Unfortunately, they did not know of a particular secret.

Their leaders, primordial immortals, were part of the clandestine Heaven Essence and Immortal Hunt Alliance.

Immortal Hunt moved in the shadows, even with the killings. As for Heaven Essence, its only goal was the high heaven.

They only showed themselves before the start of Heaven Pit, gathering a mighty force of immortals and overlords. They utilized unimaginable resources to create a battlefield like no other.
